verses.text_en: And this is the Second Parable concerning those who deny the name of the dwelling of the holy ones and the Lord of Spirits.
verses.text_hr: Ovo je Druga prispodoba o onima koji niječu ime prebivališta svetih i Gospodara duhova.

verses.text_en:
And into the heaven they shall not ascend,
And on the earth they shall not come:
Such shall be the lot of the sinners
Who have denied the name of the Lord of Spirits,
Who are thus preserved for the day of suffering and tribulation.
verses.text_hr:
Oni neće uzaći na nebo
niti će doći na zemlju.
Takva će biti baština grešnika
koji su zanijekali ime Gospodara duhova
i tako se čuvaju za dan patnje i nevolje.

verses.text_en:
On that day Mine Elect, One shall sit on the throne of glory
And shall =try= their works,
And their places of rest shall be innumerable.
And their souls shall grow strong within them when they see Mine elect ones,
And those who have called upon My glorious name:
verses.text_hr:
Toga će dana moj Izabrani sjesti na prijestolje slave
i ispitati njihova djela,
a njegovim počivalištima neće biti broja.
Njihove će duše ojačati u njima kad vide moje izabrane
i one koji su zazvali moje slavno ime.

verses.text_en:
Then will I cause Mine Elect One to dwell among them.
And I will transform the heaven and make it an eternal blessing and light,
verses.text_hr:
Tada ću svojega Izabranoga nastaniti među njima.
Preobrazit ću nebo i učiniti ga vječnim blagoslovom i svjetlošću.

verses.text_en:
And I will transform the earth and make it a blessing:
And I will cause Mine elect ones to dwell upon it:
But the sinners and evil-doers shall not set foot thereon.
verses.text_hr:
Preobrazit ću zemlju i učiniti je blagoslovom,
te na njoj nastaniti svoje izabrane.
Ali grešnici i zločinci neće na nju stupiti.

verses.text_en:
For I have provided and satisfied with peace My righteous ones,
And have caused them to dwell before Me:
But for the sinners there is judgement impending with Me,
So that I shall destroy them from the face of the earth.
verses.text_hr:
Jer svojim sam pravednicima pribavio mir i njime ih nasitio
te ih nastanio pred sobom.
Ali kod mene grešnike čeka sud,
da ih uništim s lica zemlje.
